name: Hakuren
source:
"I said I was going to take you with me, those words weren't a lie."

A white snake ayakashi that suddenly appears before the protagonist.
He's always calm and kind, but whether that is his true personality is unknown.
He has a high-class air about him, a bit of a playboy.
